outline:
本課程將簡要介紹聚合物化學、聚合物的結構、形態和流變學，以及它們的機械、熱學、電學、光學和化學性質，並結合參考文獻中的例子進行闡述。
This course will cover the brief introduction of polymer chemistry, the structure, morphology, and rheology of polymers and their mechanical, thermal, electrical, optical and chemical properties together with the examples from references.
schedule:
Week 1: General introduction of polymer chemistry
Week 2: Gel Permeation Chromatography, GPC
Week 3: Analysis examples from references (GPC)
Week 4: Differential Scanning Calorimetry, DSC
Week 5: Analysis examples from references (DSC)
Week 6: Thermogravimetric Analysis,TGA
Week 7: Analysis examples from references (TGA)
Week 8: Dynamic Mechanical Analysis, (DMA)
Week 9: Mid-Exam*
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Week 10: Analysis examples from references (DMA)
Week 11: Rheometer
Week 12: Analysis examples from references (Rheometer)
Week 13: X-ray Diffractometer, XRD
Week 14: Analysis examples from references (XRD)
Week 15: Infrared, IR
Week 16: Final-Exam*
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Week 17: Flexible Learning (Ultraviolet-Visible Spectrophotometer,UV)
Week 18: Flexible Learning (Photoluminescence spectrometer, PL)

flexible_learning.content:
採用預錄製課程之教材，請同學於彈性週進行線上學習，並可以持續複習至第二週，第二週結束有課程相關的習題作業需要繳交，彈性週作業占總成績10%。
The course materials will be pre-recorded. Students are requested to study online during the flexible week and can continue to review until the second week. At the end of the second week, there will be course-related exercises to be submitted. The flexible week assignments will account for 10% of the total grade.
flexible_learning.outcome:
學習成果方式為繳交相關作業。
The learning outcome is the submission of relevant assignments.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio:

The flexible week assessment score accounts for 10% of the total score.
